name: chai-typed-database-sql-result-metadata-2b01
instr:
Chai cannot report SELECT types and nullability before evaluating expressions or creating an iterator. Add structural metadata for direct, prepared, and empty results, covering literals, bound columns, casts, scalar functions, LOWER, and AVG. Keep database/sql metadata aligned with existing names and values.

Literals infer INTEGER, TEXT, BOOLEAN, TIMESTAMP, bytes, or NULL from values. Bound columns use catalog types and declared nullability; unbound columns remain unknown. Casts replace the type while preserving source nullability. Nested expressions compose without evaluation. AVG promotes INTEGER, BIGINT, and DOUBLE PRECISION and is nullable for empty input. LOWER reports TEXT and is nullable for nullable or incompatible arguments.

Definition-backed scalar functions apply declared inference to ordered argument metadata. Definitions without inference remain executable and explicitly unknown. Preserve projection order, duplicates, aliases, and wildcard expansion order. Every database/sql Columns entry exposes aligned database type name, supported nullable status, and scan type from the same stream schema. Inspection must not consume rows or change naming, value conversion, EOF behavior, errors, or close-time transaction finalization.

github.com/chaisql/chai/internal/expr provides ResultType, TypeResolver, Expr, NewLiteralExpr, NewColumnExpr, and NewCastExpr; github.com/chaisql/chai/internal/expr/functions provides ResultTypeFunc, ScalarDefinition.SetResultType, NewLowerExp
